ideas.pitch: An interactive personal portfolio designed entirely as a fully functional, browser-based Linux terminal interface for developers who want to showcase their skills through code commands.
ideas.problem_statement: Skillinf Portfolio Design Hackathon 2026: Create an original, professional, and visually impressive portfolio website that represents your skills and personality.
ideas.title: Terminal Portfolio: The CLI Developer Experience
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in design and developer portfolios are fatigued by standard templates; a fully interactive CLI with custom bash-like commands for projects, skills, and resume download instantly sets it apart on uniqueness and technical flair.

ideas.pitch: A modern bento-box style portfolio featuring embedded Three.js 3D interactive canvases, dynamic skill constellations, and live GitHub commit heatmaps transformed into architectural blocks.
ideas.problem_statement: Skillinf Portfolio Design Hackathon 2026: Create an original, professional, and visually impressive portfolio website that represents your skills and personality.
ideas.title: BentoGrid 3D: Interactive Holographic Portfolio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages cutting-edge web graphics and smooth micro-interactions which directly target the hackathon's core emphasis on creativity, visual appeal, and modern web technologies.

ideas.pitch: A portfolio where your career history, projects, and tech stack are visualized as an interactive force-directed graph network, allowing visitors to click nodes to explore relationships between skills and shipped apps.
ideas.problem_statement: Skillinf Portfolio Design Hackathon 2026: Create an original, professional, and visually impressive portfolio website that represents your skills and personality.
ideas.title: ResumeGraph: Dynamic Knowledge-Graph Portfolio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Takes data visualization concepts from winning engineering tools and applies them to personal branding, showcasing deep technical prowess far beyond a static resume.

ideas.pitch: A portfolio website built with synchronized audio-visual storytelling, featuring spatial audio cues, scrollytelling animations, and an AI-voiced walkthrough of key project highlights.
ideas.problem_statement: Skillinf Portfolio Design Hackathon 2026: Create an original, professional, and visually impressive portfolio website that represents your skills and personality.
ideas.title: AudioCVMeta: The Immersive Narrative Portfolio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Multi-sensory web design creates an unforgettable judging experience, scoring maximum points for innovation, user experience, and creative deployment of browser APIs.

ideas.pitch: A portfolio web application that automatically updates its featured projects, recent blog posts, and live coding metrics by securely syncing directly with GitHub and external developer APIs.
ideas.problem_statement: Skillinf Portfolio Design Hackathon 2026: Create an original, professional, and visually impressive portfolio website that represents your skills and personality.
ideas.title: GitStream Portfolio: Live Activity-Driven Showcase
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the static nature of standard portfolios by making the site a living, breathing dashboard of ongoing engineering work, appealing heavily to technical judges.
